Q953.reason: A unit out of controlled cold storage beyond the time limit must be returned to the blood bank for quarantine or disposal, not transfused, ward-refrigerated, or discarded in the sluice.

Q954.reason: Consent, washing the patient, and checking expiry dates are routine before aseptic catheterization; contacting next of kin is not.

Q916.reason: Lower gauge means a wider bore, so 14–16G cannulae are used for rapid volume replacement in trauma or burns, not children, frail elderly patients, or routine hand veins.
